intro.heading: Planning Your First River Cruise
leadParagraphs: Planning your first Uniworld River Cruise is exciting, especially if you've never experienced river cruising before.

Unlike large ocean cruises, Uniworld Boutique River Cruises focuses on intimate ships, immersive cultural experiences, luxury accommodations, and personalized service. Understanding what to expect before you sail can help you choose the right itinerary, pack appropriately, and make the most of every day onboard.
This guide covers everything first-time guests should know—from booking your cruise and selecting a cabin to dining, excursions, onboard etiquette, and practical travel tips.

faqs.question: Is Uniworld good for first-time river cruisers?
faqs.answer: Yes. Its all-inclusive experience and personalized service make it an excellent choice for first-time guests.

faqs.question: Which Uniworld itinerary is best for beginners?
faqs.answer: The Danube and Rhine itineraries are often recommended because they combine scenic cruising with iconic destinations.

faqs.question: What should I pack for a Uniworld River Cruise?
faqs.answer: Pack comfortable walking shoes, smart casual clothing, travel documents, weather-appropriate layers, and a day bag for excursions.

faqs.question: Are excursions included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most itineraries include guided shore excursions.

faqs.question: Is Wi-Fi included onboard?
faqs.answer: Yes. Complimentary Wi-Fi is generally available throughout the ship.

faqs.question: Do I need formal clothes?
faqs.answer: No. Smart casual attire is suitable for most evenings.

faqs.question: What is included in the cruise fare?
faqs.answer: Typically, accommodations, meals, beverages, excursions, gratuities, Wi-Fi, and entertainment are included.

faqs.question: Are river cruises suitable for older travelers?
faqs.answer: Yes. River cruises are popular with travelers seeking a relaxed pace and cultural experiences.

faqs.question: Can I explore destinations on my own?
faqs.answer: Yes. Guests usually have free time to explore independently alongside included excursions.

faqs.question: Should I arrive before embarkation day?
faqs.answer: Yes. Arriving one day early helps reduce the risk of travel delays affecting your cruise.

faqs.question: How much walking is involved?
faqs.answer: Most excursions include moderate walking, often on cobblestone streets or uneven surfaces.

faqs.question: Can dietary restrictions be accommodated?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most dietary requirements can be accommodated with advance notice.

faqs.question: Are drinks included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Premium wines, spirits, beer, soft drinks, coffee, and tea are generally included.

faqs.question: Which cabin should first-time travelers choose?
faqs.answer: French Balcony cabins offer an excellent combination of comfort, scenic views, and value.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I book?
faqs.answer: Booking six to twelve months before departure often provides the best cabin availability and promotional pricing.
